2577-5256-7084-8345.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5256-7084-8345.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2265-3099-4762-8320.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting three +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Hardened Scales and Yoshimaru.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2085-4613-6858.easyPrerequisites:
Oreskos Sun Guide doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kelpie Guide is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
2085-4613-6858.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2085-4613-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide using Kelpie Guide's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Kelpie Guide's ability by tapping it, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

147-997-1893.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-997-1893.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-728-1472-5626.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-728-1472-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

728-1981-2415-3641.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1981-2415-3641.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

586-864-997-2279-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-997-2279-3125.description:
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

225-4365-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

215-539-1129-7781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Allies.
215-539-1129-7781.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Harabaz Druid
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

6965-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6965-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6965-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

2726-3771-7043.description:
Cast Aang by paying {W}{U}
Reflections of Littjara and Animar trigger.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Reflections of Littjara trigger, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. When it enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Cast the Aang spell from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. Put either Aang token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aang token from step 5 enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Repeat from step 6.

206-1563-2457-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

4242-4659-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi with haste.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Su-Chi token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi token dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

643-2366-6798-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
643-2366-6798-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-4136-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1308-4136-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Roaring Earth
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

315-4465-5447--138.notablePrerequisites: You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
315-4465-5447--138.description:
Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

662-1978-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
662-1978-3043.description:
Cause Axebane Guardian to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

1778-2173-5220-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-1308-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-1308-4772.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

2457-3129-4321-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2744-4659-5003-6554.manaNeeded: {2} if Mister Gutsy doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
2744-4659-5003-6554.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mister Gutsy, adding {C}{C}.
When Mister Gutsy dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Mister Gutsy trigger, creating a number of Junk tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on it.
If you created a Junk token, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Junk, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mister Gutsy from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Mister Gutsy enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

2557-5189-5641.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2557-5189-5641.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate an Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Blitzwing, Cruel Tormentor // Blitzwing, Adaptive Assailant

156-5008.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
156-5008.description:
Cast Scourge of the Skyclaves with kicker by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Scourge of the Skyclaves triggers, causing each player to lose life equal to half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Blitzwing triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1779-2177-3096.manaNeeded: {6}{R/G}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
1779-2177-3096.notablePrerequisites: You control a non-Human nontoken creature.
1779-2177-3096.description:
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}, exiling all nonland permanent cards from your library.
Cast Illuna either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R/G}{U}{U} and command tax, if applicable, putting it over or under a non-Human nontoken creature you control.
Illuna triggers, exiling your library.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two cards and you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

997-4504-4766.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Endless Cockroaches.
Endless Cockroaches dies, triggering itself and Deathrender.
Resolve the Endless Cockroaches trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Endless Cockroaches onto the battlefield from your hand, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

708-2019-3771-5147.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast The Prismatic Piper for {0} due to Animar and Myth Unbound.
708-2019-3771-5147.description:
Cast The Prismatic Piper from the command zone by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing The Prismatic Piper.
Choose to have The Prismatic Piper return to the command zone.
Myth Unbound triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1651-4231-4732-5184-5261.notablePrerequisites: You control another artifact or creature.
1651-4231-4732-5184-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it to cast a copy of Deadly Dispute without paying its mana cost.
As an additional cost to cast Deadly Dispute, sacrifice a creature or artifact.
Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating a Food token, a Clue token, and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clue token and the Food token to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.
